newsitem.title: JAPAN: Fujita obtains S.Korea construction licence - paper.
newsitem.headline: Fujita obtains S.Korea construction licence - paper.

text.p: South Korea has given five foreign construction companies, including Japan's Fujita Corp, licences to work in South Korea, a Japanese newspaper said.

The Japanese economic daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun said South Korea is planning to open up its construction market this year and the five companies were the first foreign firms to have obtained such licences.
Licensed foreign firms will be able to participate in private-sector projects from this year and in public-sector projects from next year, it said.
